title: Pick the layout
question: Same broadcast-gallery world, three layouts for the video screen. Web review (last card) follows whichever you pick. Approve one, or steer below (e.g. 'Focus, but with the rundown').

options.label: Gallery
options.thesis: Picture with a monitor wall of earlier notes underneath and a talkback panel on the right.
options.viewport: PGM monitor left, four note monitors below, TALKBACK column with the big ON button and the note log.
options.risk: The monitor wall takes height from the picture.

options.label: Rundown
options.thesis: Your notes as a newsroom running order down the left; the picture center; one desk row with TALK.
options.viewport: RUNDOWN list with thumbnails left, PGM center, TALK + caption + mark keys + transport below, timeline across the bottom.

options.label: Focus
options.thesis: The picture owns the screen; notes live in a slim tally rail; everything you press sits on one production desk.
options.viewport: PGM at ~85% width, numbered tally tabs on the right with the open note expanded, a desk strip with TALK (T), meter, caption, marks, transport and timecode.
options.risk: Notes are compact while recording; you read them in full on the review screen.

options.label: Web review (applies to all)
options.thesis: Your site with Dictate's pins and floating toolbar; the panel docks on the right with the last screenshot, TALK, and the log.
options.viewport: Site ~68% with P2 pin, B1 box and TALKING chip; docked panel ~32%.
options.risk: Choosing this card approves the web panel only; I'll use Focus for video unless you steer.
